compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a list of crime movies available for viewing. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Category Title**: The top of the screen shows the category "Crime".
2. **Navigation Tabs**: Below the category title, there are tabs to filter the movies by "All", "Free", "Premium", and "Rental".
3. **Movie Listings**: A list of crime movies is displayed, each with the following details:
   - **Movie Title**: The name of the movie (e.g., "Dhoom 3").
   - **Release Year**: The year the movie was released (e.g., 2013).
   - **Rating**: A star rating for the movie (e.g., 4 stars).
   - **Format Icons**: Icons indicating the availability of HD and Closed Captions (CC).
   - **Duration**: The length of the movie (e.g., 2h 51
